thread:
anna: quick sync re: prober granularity and slowpath routing for new model onboarding pipeline — want alignment before i PR
kevin: got it. what's the core tradeoff you're thinking?
maria: we need to avoid full-benching every model; cost explodes
anna: yes. proposal: two-tier probes — micro-probes (1% samples, 1-3 inputs, <200ms) and macro-probes (full bench for gated stage)
jamal: micro-probes can catch obvious regressions quickly. how do we signal them to runtime?
anna: add header 'X-Onboard-Probe: micro|macro' and 'X-Slice-ID' for telemetry
sara: would like 'slice_id' in traces too so we can correlate with golden groups
ethan: slowpath routing idea: route macro-probes and heavy evals to a dedicated slowpath pool with backpressure and rate limit
kevin: so heavy bench traffic doesn't steal production capacity. agree.
anna: keep routing policy simple: if probe==macro -> route=slowpath; else route=fastpath. add fallback: if slowpath saturated -> enqueue + sampling degrade
maria: need contract: slowpath accepts 'async=true' and a callback webhook for results
jamal: also add size limit header so very large models don't blow up memory: 'X-Model-Max-Tokens'
sara: telemetry keys: 'onboard.probe.type', 'onboard.slice.id', 'onboard.runtime.route', 'onboard.goldset.hit'
devx-bot: reminder: update onboarding docs and SDK flag for 'probe_type' when we land this
ops-bot: note: will create slowpath-cluster autoscale policy template (min=1,max=10) and RBAC for onboarding jobs
anna: decision check: implement headers + route policy + slowpath cluster + webhook async contract. i'll open RFC PR with interface sketch and sample curl.
kevin: thx — if you can add a tiny example payload in RFC that shows headers and expected JSON webhook shape that helps oncall
anna: will do. quick example in thread:

```bash
curl -X POST https://ingest.internal/onboard/run \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'X-Onboard-Probe: macro' \
  -H 'X-Slice-ID: sg-12' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"awesome-7b","async":true,"webhook":"https://hooks.example/cb"}'
```

kevin: perfect. one more: add a healthcheck metric for slowpath queue length
anna: noted. ok i’ll draft PR today, tagging infra + runtime for impl estimates :thumbsup:
